artworks.title: Edwin Forrest
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man showing the upper half of his body, positioned slightly turned to one side. He has a serious expression with a prominent mustache and slightly disheveled dark hair that appears to be thinning at the crown. He is dressed in formal attire, wearing a black coat over a white shirt with a high collar and a black bow tie. A gold hoop in the buttonhole of his coat adds a small note of detail. The background is a simple, softly shaded neutral color.

artworks.title: Joseph Wesley Harper, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an older man from the shoulders up. He is facing slightly to the right, with his gaze directed off-camera. The man has a large, bushy beard that is a mix of white and reddish tones. He has a receding hairline with short, thinning hair on top. He is dressed in a dark suit jacket, set against a dark background that highlights his face and facial hair. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: John Peck
artworks.description: The image shows a man with fair skin, blonde curly hair, and facial features including a straight nose and arched eyebrows. He is wearing a dark jacket and a white cravat, against a dark background with a hint of burgundy cloth on the right side. No jewelry or items are visible.

artworks.title: Abraham Lincoln
artworks.description: This painting depicts the upper body of a man in a seated position, facing us. He has pale skin, a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a neutral expression. His dark hair is styled back, and his dark beard is neatly trimmed. He is dressed in a black suit with a white shirt and a black bow tie. The brown background is lighter near the center of the painting and darker near the edges.

artworks.title: William Morris Hunt
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to his right and looking to his left. The man has a long white beard, closely shaven hair, deeply set eyes, and a slightly furrowed brow. He is wearing a black jacket over a grey waistcoat and trousers. A gold chain is visible around his neck and tucked into the waistcoat. He has a ring on his left hand and is holding a black top hat with his right hand. The background is plain and dark, providing a contrast to his light clothing and beard.

artworks.title: Eliab Metcalf (?)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body. He is facing the left side of the frame but looking directly at the viewer. He has short, dark hair, sideburns, dark eyes, and a clean-shaven face. The man is wearing a black coat over a white shirt with a white cravat. His arms are crossed in front of him. The background has a gradient from dark to light brown, with a hint of red drapery on the left.

artworks.title: Cora Livingston
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a woman seated in a red chair against a warm brown backdrop. She is holding a guitar across her lap. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo with curls and waves framing her face. She has a neutral expression and fair skin with a rosy complexion. She wears a burgundy velvet dress with a wide neckline, revealing her shoulders. The dress's fabric gathers slightly near the neckline. Her hands are resting on the guitar's body and neck, suggesting a relaxed posture. There is no visible jewelry, and the background features a textured drapery.

artworks.title: Mr. Van Vechten
artworks.description: This painting depicts a man standing, seen from the waist up. He has one hand resting on his hip and the other pointing downwards towards the bottom-left corner of the painting, holding two small objects that look like pieces of wheat. He has a slight smile, pale skin, a long nose, and long, dark hair falling in waves to his shoulders. He is wearing a brown coat with large buttons and wide cuffs, a matching waistcoat, and a white cravat. The background shows dark red-brown drapery on the right and an outdoor scene on the left, perhaps a window, showing tall, slender trees under a dark blue sky.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The painting depicts the upper half of a man standing straight and facing us. He has pale skin, rosy cheeks, a long nose, strong brows, and sideburns that lead to his curly, gray-brown hair. He is wearing a black coat over a high-collared white shirt. In one hand he holds papers, while in the other hand he holds a pair of nearly-invisible spectacles against his torso. His right arm is bent and resting on a surface next to him on the left, and there is an inkwell with a quill and a paper on a lower desk or surface on the right. The background is dark brown with some visible brushstrokes.

artworks.title: Amy Taylor Dickson (Mrs. John Dickson)
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a seated woman, facing slightly left with her head turned towards the viewer. Her right hand rests on her chest. She has soft facial features, gentle eyes, a straight nose, and slightly pursed lips. She wears a dark garment with long sleeves, complemented by a light-colored lace shawl or collar. Her dark hair is covered by an ornately layered lace cap. The background is a simple, muted brown, likely wood-paneled.

artworks.title: Thomas W. Dyott
artworks.description: The image shows an older man with a composed expression and grey hair wearing circular spectacles, a dark coat, and a cravat tied around his neck. He is facing slightly to the right and looking towards the viewer. The background is dark and unobtrusive.

artworks.title: William Crook Rudman, Jr.
artworks.description: The portrait shows a young man seated with his body turned slightly to the side, facing toward the viewer. He has fair skin and neatly styled, light brown hair that is parted to one side. His face is smooth and youthful, with prominent cheekbones and a defined jawline. He wears a dark coat over a white shirt with a decorative patterned edge. A vivid blue bow tie is neatly tied around his neck. Draped over his waistcoat, a gold chain features a circular pendant and a key-like ornament. His right hand is resting on two large books positioned in front of him, one of which has 'SILVAN' and 'SHONBERG' inscribed on its spine in gold letters. The background consists of a plain, softly shaded wall, with a small portion showing a distant landscape outside a window on the left, depicting a serene natural scene.

artworks.title: The Reverend John Albert Ryan
artworks.description: The image is a portrait painting of a man's upper body. The man is facing the viewer directly, slightly leaning back. He has a round face with prominent cheeks and fair complexion. His hair is short, curly, and gray, framing his face. He is wearing a dark coat over a waistcoat and a high white cravat tied elegantly around his neck. The background is warm, muted brown. There are no visible objects or jewelry. The painting is signed by the artist on the left side with the name "Noyes" and the year "1829".

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.description: The image displays an upper-body portrait of a seated woman. She has fair skin, rosy cheeks, dark hair styled in tight curls, and is wearing a white lace bonnet with ribbons. She is dressed in a dark dress with white lace at the neckline and has a subtle smile on her face. The background is a plain, warm brown color with a lighter area on the left.

artworks.title: Richardson Stuart
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body, focusing on his head and shoulders. He is facing slightly left, looking at the viewer. The man has fair skin, dark eyes, and slightly arched eyebrows. His hair is dark brown with a few grey strands and styled in soft waves. He is wearing a dark jacket, a white high-collared shirt, and a light-colored cravat. The background is a uniform warm tone.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Gentleman
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man facing the viewer directly with a slight turn to his left. He has a serious expression with distinct facial features, fair complexion, round cheeks, and voluminous, tight curls framing his face. He is dressed in a historical coat with gold buttons and trim, a white high-collared shirt, and a cravat. The background is a muted, dark brown tone.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Gentleman
artworks.description: The image features an older man with distinctive facial features and white curly hair, dressed in formal attire against a plain brown background.

artworks.title: General William Smallwood
artworks.description: A pale-skinned man wearing a military uniform is shown from the waist up in this vertical portrait painting. His body is angled to our left with his arms by his sides, and he looks in that direction with brown eyes under curving brows. He has a straight, pointed nose, slightly pursed pink lips, and a double chin. His white hair is brushed back from a high forehead and tied at the back of his neck. His dark blue jacket has a shiny gold epaulet decorated with two silver stars on the shoulder we can see. The jacket has wide, butter-yellow trim around the neck and down the front over a frilly, ruffled cravat. The coat has brass buttons, and a dark blue and pale yellow medal with a gold eagle is pinned to the lapel. The background is golden brown to the right of the man and darkens to coffee brown along the left edge.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, angled slightly to the left, with her right arm resting on a surface and her left hand on her lap. She has a composed expression with light-colored eyes and fair skin. Her hair is light brown, styled smoothly. She wears a deep blue gown with billowing sleeves trimmed with white lace. The neckline is slightly open, revealing a white chemise. The background is dark, contrasting with the subject. The woman appears dignified, without any visible jewelry.

artworks.title: Frances Ludlum Morris (Mrs. Robert Morris) (?)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a red armchair. She is depicted from the waist up with her hands folded in her lap, holding a white lace handkerchief. She has a neutral expression, dark eyes, and wears a dark gown with intricate detailing, a white lace collar, and a lace bonnet with a ribbon. The background is plain and dark.
